name: PyPI (JSON API and organisation pages)
tier_rationale: Operated by the Python Software Foundation with published terms (A8): 'Registry: npm (GitHub), PyPI (PSF), DEV/Forem and Hugging Face tier trusted' (P100 cond 8); 'Registry: GitHub, GitLab, npm, PyPI and Docker trusted' (P359 cond 9).

reliability.justification: Authoritative package metadata (JSON API) and organisation pages; author and maintainer fields are self-asserted.

json_api.title: PyPI JSON API /pypi/{package}/json and /pypi/{package}/{version}/json

terms.quote: Registry: npm (GitHub), PyPI (PSF), DEV/Forem and Hugging Face tier trusted, Codeberg e.V. community; all terms open; personal_data_review before default use (A3 BR8).

json_api.notes: Research C0253 terms 'PyPI ToS.' (CDN cached; generous). Endpoints /pypi/{package}/json and /pypi/{package}/{version}/json, only for package names already in the case (PyPI has no user API, P100 cond 3). Never /user/* (JS Client Challenge): a challenge is BLOCKED reason challenge via a P321 marker the owning batch adds with its fixture, never ABSENT (P100 cond 4, P359 cond 8). Used by dev_profiles_pack and org_code_footprint.

org_pages.title: PyPI organisation pages /org/{org}/ (HTML, one polite request per org)

terms.quote: Sources: GitHub REST 'key-terms' (as P111); GitLab, Codeberg, npm, PyPI and Docker Hub 'open'.

org_pages.notes: Research C0761 terms 'PyPI terms of use.' HTML organisation page /org/{org}/, one polite request per org, cache 7 days (the provider ttl cap allows it). Used by org_code_footprint.

notes: Seeded once for batches p2-G05-1 and p2-G05-2 (P100, P359). ttl 604800 is the cap needed for the 7-day org-page cache (research C0761); JSON metadata calls may ask a shorter TTL. Limits undocumented (CDN cached): no quota block.
